title: Sine Wave Function
text: Generate sine wave, using external signal as time source, 1 input, 1 output, direct feedthrough; {Sine type} sets the type of sine wave, {Time (t)} sets the source of time variable Use external, {Amplitude}, {Bias} sets the constant added to sine wave, {Frequency (rad/sec)} sets the frequency of sine wave, {Phase (rad)} sets the phase shift of sine wave, {Samples per period}, {Number of offset samples} sets the offset in number of time samples, {Sample time} sets the sample period and {Interpret vector parameters as 1-D} sets the output dimensions for one-row or one-column. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Sine type
params.values: Type of sine wave Time based (default) | Sample based

params.name: Time (t)
params.values: Source of time variable Use external signal (default) | Use simulation time

params.name: Amplitude
params.values: Amplitude of the sine wave 1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Bias
params.values: Constant added to sine wave 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Phase (rad)
params.values: Phase shift of sine wave 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Number of offset samples
params.values: Offset in number of time samples 0 (default) | integer

params.name: Interpret vector parameters as 1-D
params.values: Output dimensions for one-row or one-column matrices off (default) | on
